# AutoLounge

> AutoLounge is an Android app that brings YouTube, 100+ live TV channels, streaming sites and radio to the Android Auto car screen. Video plays only while the car is parked; when it moves, the picture turns off and audio keeps playing. No root is needed, and every new device gets a 60-minute free trial.

## Key facts
- Price: Lifetime VIP license, one-time payment, no subscription. 199 TRY in Turkey, EUR 11.99 in the EU, USD 12.99 elsewhere.
- Free trial: 60 minutes on each new device, counted only while video plays on the car screen.
- Devices: 1 license works on 2 devices; self-service transfer to a new phone.
- Distribution: APK from GitHub Releases; license sold on the website (Shopier for Turkey, LemonSqueezy elsewhere). Not on Google Play.
- Safety: driving safety lockout hides video when the car moves; audio continues.
- Languages: app UI in 11 languages (Turkish, English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Russian, Arabic, Hindi, Chinese).
- Country-aware: the live TV list and home shortcuts adapt to the user's country (SIM or region).

## Install (by Android version)
- Android 15 and newer: install the APK normally, then enable Android Auto "Unknown sources".
- Android 14: install Shizuku, then use KingInstaller's "Shizuku Trick" to install the APK; also enable Android Auto "Unknown sources".
- Android 13 and below: install with KingInstaller using "Install as Google Play Store"; also enable Android Auto "Unknown sources".
